excerpt.zh: 来自[FromFrom.GetName]的滔天毒流渐渐平息，[From.GetName]上生意盎然的生态系统不复存在，充满毒气的星球中唯有少数几种生命形式能繁衍生息。
excerpt.en: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.

texts.zh: 来自[FromFrom.GetName]的滔天毒流渐渐平息，[From.GetName]上生意盎然的生态系统不复存在，充满毒气的星球中唯有少数几种生命形式能繁衍生息。
texts.en: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.

texts.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
texts.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

texts.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队摧毁了[From.GetName]的[From.GetPlanetMoon]，杀害了滋生在星球表面的[GetPreFTLLower]文明。结果就是，这里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
texts.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have destroyed the [From.GetPlanetMoon] of [From.GetName], killing the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization that flourished on the surface. As a result, there is now nothing left to observe there...

texts.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队已经将[From.GetName]包裹在了不可穿透的护盾中，使得我们不可能继续对滋生在星球表面上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明继续进行观测……
texts.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have encased [From.GetName] in an impenetrable shield, making it impossible for us to continue observing the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization flourishing on the surface...

texts.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队已经将滋生在[From.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明进行了清除。结果，这里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
texts.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have wiped out the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization that flourished on [From.GetName]. As a result, there is now nothing left to observe there...

# 行星被毒化 / Planet Toxified

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/planet_destruction_events.txt:2267-2578; common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:146-150 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

玩家用巨像的“毒流天降”武器毁掉/改造一颗行星时（common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:146-150），隐藏事件触发；若星球有所有者且不是自己，所有者的对手即玩家获得叙事窗口 planet_destruction.801。星球不能是栖息地或环世界。

When the player's Colossus fires "Toxifier" at a planet (common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:146-150) the hidden dispatcher fires; if the planet has an owner that is not the firing country, a narrative window planet_destruction.801 is shown to the firing player. The planet may not be a habitat or ringworld.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口 planet_destruction.801，每个国家只显示一次（国家旗标 fired_toxifier）。若星球上有观测前哨，一天后另有 planet_destruction.1000 通知；若是机械意识（Contingency）的世界则触发 crisis.2040/2046（属危机故事）。

A single window planet_destruction.801, shown once per country (country flag fired_toxifier). If the planet had an observation outpost, planet_destruction.1000 follows one day later; Contingency machine worlds trigger crisis.2040/2046 (crisis stories).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

需要巨像武器；狂热净化者与终结者机械有专属选项（获得团结）。

Needs a Colossus weapon; Fanatic Purifiers and Terminator machines have their own option (unity).

- 已核对入口、触发、选项与结果。
  Checked the entry, trigger, options and outcomes.
